role: One frame of a texture animation from a texture's .mcmeta: its index into the sprite sheet and its optional per-frame time.
scope_reason: Metadata consumed as data: RenderStateProbe.animFrames dumps each animated sprite's frame index and time (state/anim.json), which csrc/engine/texanim.c reads; the Java object never runs natively.

members.name: AnimationFrame
members.note: frameTime defaults to -1 (use the section default)
